facts.business: Delphi World Money Limited operates as an authorised dealer in retail foreign exchange, cross-border remittances, and multicurrency prepaid card solutions for students, travellers, and corporates.

auditor.name: T R Chadha & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to insufficient evidence regarding business rationale of inter-corporate deposits by subsidiary Ebix Travel Private Limited to ultimate holding company Eraaya Lifespaces Limited (Rs 532.84 million during FY2026, outstanding Rs 456.38 million). Emphasis of matter on ED adjudication orders imposing penalty of Rs 329.07 million on company and Rs 35.20 million on principal officer for FEMA non-compliance (pre-acquisition period, covered by indemnities), and ongoing legal proceedings by Bull Value Incorporated VCC Sub-Fund challenging shareholding transfer, with interim status quo order.

key_risks: Regulatory and legal proceedings including ED penalties under FEMA and ongoing litigation challenging shareholding transfer
Material related party transactions (inter-corporate deposits) without prior shareholder approval
Substantial outstanding statutory dues and operational liabilities at ultimate holding company level
Dependence on IT systems for high-volume revenue processing and cash handling risks
Contingent liabilities from regulatory, direct and indirect tax disputes
facts.related_party_note: Subsidiary Ebix Travel Private Limited gave inter-corporate deposits of Rs 532.84 million to ultimate holding company Eraaya Lifespaces Limited during FY2026 (outstanding Rs 456.38 million including interest as at March 31, 2026), without prior shareholder approval as required under Regulation 23 of Listing Regulations. Shareholder approval obtained subsequently via postal ballot on April 11, 2026. ED penalties of Rs 329.07 million on company and Rs 35.20 million on principal officer for pre-acquisition FEMA non-compliance, covered by indemnities from erstwhile promoters.
